title: Betty Andreasson Luca told that Nordic angels brought Christ
place_text: Andreasson family home; underground or underwater location

tellings.quote: And these tall angelic beings told her that they brought Christ into the world and don't worry, they're going to bring him back again soon.

plain: A philosopher and researcher, Jason Jorjani, speaking on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, retells the story of a woman named Betty Andreasson Luca, who says she was visited at her family home in the 1960s and taken to a place underground or underwater. According to Jorjani, tall, angel-like beings, the human-looking kind often called "Nordics", told her that they had brought Christ into the world and would soon bring him back. If true, it would mean that visitors from elsewhere claim a hand in the origins of a world religion.
